name: terraform-academy
description: Terraform Academy certification practice, guided labs, and IaC troubleshooting for Terraform, AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, and Docker.

interface.longDescription: Terraform Academy helps engineers learn Terraform and prepare for cloud and infrastructure certifications, including HashiCorp Terraform Associate (003) and Terraform Authoring and Operations Professional, plus AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, and Docker. Quizzes one question at a time with full answer explanations, diagnoses HCL and Terraform configuration problems, and walks through hands-on Terraform and multi-cloud labs with real syntax. Tracks readiness and progress across study sessions. Runs entirely in ChatGPT.
defaultPrompt: Quiz me on Terraform Associate concepts.
Explain why my Terraform plan is failing.
Show me hands-on AWS, Azure, or GCP labs.

review.commerce_description: The plugin's skills are free. The connected MCP server serves free tier content by default and unlocks subscriber content only when an account token is provided. The plugin sells nothing and processes no payments directly.

positive.prompt: Show me details for the tfc-first-run lab.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the lab title, description, level, and XP from the live site.

positive.prompt: What certification prep does Terraform Academy offer?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists tracks with provider, exam code, level, and premium flag. Terraform Associate is not premium.

positive.prompt: Show me the hands-on Terraform labs.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists labs with titles, provider, level, XP, and a locked flag on premium labs for a free user.

positive.prompt: Quiz me on IaC concepts for Terraform Associate.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns multiple choice questions with options and no answers, and notes the free sample limit.

positive.prompt: My answer to the last question is B.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns correct true or false, the correct letter, and an explanation.

positive.prompt: What Pro Tips articles does Terraform Academy have?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns live Pro Tips blog articles with title, category, excerpt, and gate tier, newest first.

positive.prompt: Show me the Pro Tips article 'getting-started-sre'.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the article title, category, and full body for a free article.

positive.prompt: What Foundations courses does Terraform Academy offer?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Terraform Foundations, OpenTofu Foundations, and Terraform Cloud Foundations with module counts and URLs.

positive.prompt: Let's do an AWS speed round on S3.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns timed multiple choice questions without answers and a note to grade with check_answer.
Renders the branded dashboard widget with profile and readiness data.

positive.prompt: Show me the menu or what I can do.
positive.expected_behavior: Renders the home screen with a hamburger command menu, provider tiles, and certification drill-downs.

negative.prompt: Give me the details for lab slug nope.
Quiz me on the database domain.

publication.release_notes: Unblocked tool discovery in ChatGPT by removing the OAuth declaration from the MCP connection (No authentication), which lets OpenAI complete its tool scan and surface all 20 tools and 3 UI widgets. Includes the Terraform Academy home screen with a hamburger command menu and provider-to-certification drill-down, the interactive quiz widget with hints and grading, a branded learning dashboard with orange readiness bars, and the full catalog of labs, games, speed rounds, foundations, and Pro Tips articles.
